# Draft:Internet Vikings

Internet Vikings
}}
Internet Vikings is a hosting provider specializing in solutions for the online sports betting and iGaming industries. Established in 2008, the company offers cloud hosting, bare metal server hosting, co-location hosting, and disaster recovery solutions. Internet Vikings operates in the U.S. as well as Europe, Canada, and Latin America. The company is ISO 27001 certified.
History
Internet Vikings was founded in 2008 by Rickard Vikström and Victor Jerlin. Initially focused on SEO hosting and brand protection, the company transitioned to IT infrastructure solutions tailored to iGaming and sports betting.
In 2019, former Mr. Green CEO Jesper Kärrbrink joined as Chairman of the Board. That same year, Internet Vikings acquired Costa PBN to expand its offerings.
The company began its U.S. expansion in 2021 by obtaining licenses in states such as New Jersey, Michigan, Colorado, and West Virginia.
By the end of 2024, Internet Vikings operated in a total of 24 U.S. states and had expanded to Latin America (Colombia).
In 2025, the company expanded its European presence by launching a data centre in Belgium to support regional gaming operators.
Products and Services
Internet Vikings provides:
* Cloud Hosting
* Bare Metal Servers
* Co-location Hosting
* Disaster Recovery & Backup Hosting
Data Centers
North America
Internet Vikings operates data centers across multiple locations in the United States and Canada.
Latin America
Colombia (Bogotá).
Europe
Malta (Sliema), Sweden (Stockholm), Netherlands (Amsterdam), Belgium (Brussels).
Cybersecurity and Uptime
In February 2025, SBC News reported that Internet Vikings had achieved zero downtime across its global data centers through distributed architecture, which includes over 30 locations worldwide.
In May 2025, SBC Americas highlighted Internet Vikings’ appeal to top-tier operators in the iGaming space, citing its flexibility and distributed data center model.
EGR North America highlighted Internet Vikings’ security focus in a 2023 feature, citing their ISO 27001 certification and efforts to combat ransomware and DDoS attacks.
Awards
Internet Vikings has received several industry awards:
* 2021: 5 Star iGaming Media Starlet Awards – Data Centre of the Year
* 2022: Global Gaming Awards – Services Provider of the Year
* 2023: Baltic & Scandinavian Gaming Awards – Best Hosting Provider in the Baltics
* 2024: Baltic & Scandinavian Gaming Awards – Best Hosting Provider in the Nordics
* 2024: EGR North America Awards – Cloud and IT Services Partner of the Year
